title: Khaemenes High Grade 9 Course Catalog
localization_note: Course titles and graduation placement may be adapted to national, state, provincial, examination, or school requirements.

pathways.label: Foundation
pathways.description: Targeted review, language support, visual instruction, and careful pacing.

pathways.label: Core
pathways.description: Complete Grade 9 learning and strong preparation for later secondary study.

pathways.label: Extended
pathways.description: Honors depth, research, unfamiliar problems, advanced applications, and early college preparation.

courses.title: Pre-Algebra
courses.summary: A mastery-based bridge from arithmetic to Algebra I through number systems, ratios, expressions, equations, graphs, geometry, statistics, and modelling.

courses.title: Algebra I
courses.summary: Linear relationships, equations, inequalities, functions, systems, exponents, polynomials, and data modelling.

courses.title: English 9: Literature, Composition & Communication
courses.summary: Reading across world literature, evidence-based writing, grammar, research, speaking, listening, and media literacy.

courses.title: International Integrated Science 9
courses.summary: A 36-week integrated course in biology, chemistry, physics, Earth and space science, environmental science, engineering, scientific inquiry, and evidence literacy.
recommended_for: Preparation for later Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Earth Science courses

courses.title: Earth, Climate & Space Science
courses.summary: Weather, climate, Earth systems, environmental observation, lunar cycles, space science, and global data literacy.

courses.title: Global Studies Honors
courses.summary: Civilizations, geography, migration, belief, exchange, conflict, governance, primary sources, and historical reasoning.

courses.title: Psychology 101: Introduction to Psychological Science
courses.summary: A 13-week evidence-centered introduction to psychological science, research methods, brain and behavior, cognition, development, social psychology, personality, health, ethics, and responsible interpretation.
recommended_for: Preparation for later psychology and social science study

courses.title: Digital Citizenship & Web Foundations
courses.summary: Digital safety, source evaluation, HTML/CSS/JavaScript foundations, file management, accessibility, and ethical technology.

courses.title: Health, Wellness & Human Development
courses.summary: Health literacy, nutrition, movement, mental wellness, safety, prevention, communication, and responsible care navigation.

courses.title: Visual Arts Foundations
courses.summary: Drawing, color, composition, visual culture, digital media, critique, portfolio development, and original work.

courses.title: Music Foundations & Creative Production
courses.summary: Notation, rhythm, listening, theory, composition, recording, performance, and music research.

courses.title: Civic Literacy & Public Life
courses.summary: Institutions, rights, responsibilities, public policy, source evaluation, community participation, and service.

courses.title: Research, Evidence & Citation Lab
courses.summary: Claims, sources, evidence, quotation, provenance, citations, bibliographies, and responsible research practice.

route_policy.note: Core course paths are repository-relative so the same package can run under STOS, a custom domain, a project path, or local static testing.
